services.name: Strategy, Portfolio & Policy Advice
services.headline: We assist in developing effective policy responses
services.summary: At Bombheq Partners we help create clarity where there is uncertainty. We help our clients simplify complex problems and determine pathways to address difficult infrastructure and policy questions.
services.fullDescription: We do this by assisting governments and large corporate clients to develop effective policy and strategy responses to emerging issues. We help clients chart direction on complex infrastructure planning, investment and project integration matters. We also help clients optimise investment portfolios and improve their governance and investment decision making to deliver the best service delivery outcomes.

Deal decisively with complex, high-friction multi-agency challenges
Develop workable, pragmatic, and defensible investment strategies
Deliver measurable public value and elevated community services
Optimise institutional governance to make the best use of scarce resources

caseStudies.title: Circular Quay Precinct Renewal
caseStudies.summary: Master planning, commercial advisory, and procurement strategy for Australia's premier harbourfront transit hub.
caseStudies.description: Circular Quay is the international gateway to Sydney, welcoming millions of visitors and daily commuters. Bombheq Partners provided strategic advisory and transaction guidance to modernise the multimodal transport interchange, integrating ferry wharves, heavy rail, light rail, and heritage assets into a cohesive, world-class civic precinct.
keyOutcomes: Multimodal transit interchange optimisation across ferry, rail, and pedestrian corridors
Innovative commercial transaction structure protecting heritage harbor assets
Seamless alignment across state agencies, commercial lessees, and maritime authorities

caseStudies.title: Cross River Rail
caseStudies.summary: Queensland's priority infrastructure initiative: a 10.2km rail line including 5.9km of twin tunnels under Brisbane River and CBD.
caseStudies.description: Cross River Rail unlocks the bottleneck at the core of the South East Queensland rail network. Bombheq Partners served as strategic and transaction advisers to the Delivery Authority, delivering commercial governance across complex underground station packages, rail integration contracts, and collaborative alliances.
keyOutcomes: Underground tunneling and station cavern commercial risk structuring
Alliance framework administration ensuring schedule fidelity
Doubled capacity for the SEQ rail corridor connecting regional communities

caseStudies.title: NSW Fast Rail
caseStudies.summary: Strategic policy, economic assessment, and procurement model development for high-speed rail connecting Sydney to regional cities.
caseStudies.description: The NSW Fast Rail network aims to transform regional economies by slashing travel times between Sydney, Newcastle, Wollongong, and Canberra. Bombheq Partners provided strategic policy guidance, international procurement benchmarking, and corridor development models to determine the optimal staging and funding pathways.
keyOutcomes: Comprehensive corridor alignment and speed trajectory analysis
International procurement benchmarking for high-speed rollingstock and civil works
Defensible economic business cases securing bipartisan investment backing
